how_to_apply: Visit the official portal at nandurbar.bhartiportal.org.
Check the detailed advertisement and ensure eligibility for your respective saja.
Register and fill out the online application form with accurate personal and educational details.
Upload scanned copies of your passport-size photograph and signature as per website instructions.
Pay the required application fee online via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, Google Pay, or PhonePe.
Submit the application form and keep a printed copy of the final submitted form and payment receipt for future reference.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted exclusively through the online portal nandurbar.bhartiportal.org; no other mode of application will be accepted. Applicants must be permanent local residents of the villages included in the specific saja they apply for. Candidates must secure a minimum of 40 marks in the written examination to qualify for further stages. The post of Revenue Servant (Kotwal) involves extensive field work; hence physical fitness is mandatory. Admit cards must be downloaded from the portal between 04/11/2026 and 10/11/2026. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates attending the written examination or document verification. Any false information or suppression of facts in the application will lead to immediate disqualification and legal action. The selection committee reserves the right to cancel, modify, or alter the recruitment process or vacancy numbers at any stage.

content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a written examination carrying 100 marks, followed by document verification of eligible candidates. Candidates must score a minimum of 40 marks in the written examination to qualify. There are 50 multiple-choice questions.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates (minimum 4th standard pass certificate) Local residency certificate / Gram Panchayat certificate proving residency in the respective saja villages Caste certificate and valid Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) certificate (valid up to 31/03/2027 where applicable) Proof of age (School Leaving Certificate or birth certificate) Character certificate from the police station Small family declaration certificate as per Maharashtra Civil Services rules Medical fitness certificate issued by an authorised medical officer (at document verification stage) Affidavit on Rs. 100/- stamp paper regarding no political party affiliation (at document verification stage)

faq.question: Q1. What is Nandurbar District Revenue Servant (Kotwal) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive conducted by the Upavibhagiya Adhikari Shahada Bhag Shahada Karyalay to fill 17 temporary vacancies for Revenue Servant (Kotwal) in Shahada and Akkalkuwa talukas.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 17 vacancies have been announced for the Revenue Servant (Kotwal) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 21/10/2026 up to 05:45 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed at least the 4th standard and be local residents of the villages within the respective saja.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 40 years of age as of 06/10/2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 600/- for Open category candidates and Rs. 500/- for Reserved category candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Nandurbar District Revenue Servant (Kotwal)?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website nandurbar.bhartiportal.org between 06/10/2026 and 21/10/2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of a written examination carrying 100 marks followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for Revenue Servant (Kotwal)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated honorarium of Rs. 16,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q10. When will the written examination be conducted?
faq.answer: The written examination is scheduled to be held on 15/11/2026.
